Upton Sinclair, The Jungle.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/upton-sinclair/the-jungle

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Upton Sinclair, the author, died 1968.

First publication of the text used: 1906 (book; serialized in 1905 in the socialist newspaper Appeal to Reason) (SE colophon: 'The Jungle was published in 1906 by Upton Sinclair.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1905 (serial) and 1906 (book, published by Doubleday), both before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so the 1906 book entered it in 2001.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published in the United States before 1931, so the United States rule settles the origin too, whatever the death year (Upton Sinclair died in 1968).

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
